title: Operator-feedback amplifier contract (L30)
description: Fast-track operator feedback to scheduler queue priority in 15min without skipping promotion gates. See ADR-053.

invariants.name: event_schema
invariants.description: 7 required fields plus kind-specific conditional fields.

invariants.name: kind_enum
must: broken_route requires route_context_hash and fails closed without it

invariants.name: high_priority_fast_track_15min
invariants.description: high priority -> scheduler queue priority in 15 min.

invariants.name: auditable_plan
invariants.description: ops_feedback produces a feedback_action_taken action plan; events.jsonl persistence is deferred to the bridge writer integration.
must: bridge_event_written remains false until bridge writer integration

invariants.name: bounded_amplification
invariants.description: fast_track_per_hour_max=10 and fast_track_global_per_hour_max=30 prevent per-operator and global storms.

invariants.name: verified_bridge_identity
invariants.description: Scheduler preflight derives operator_id from a durable bridge event envelope, not a free-string payload.
must: source bridge event present in durable bridge log

invariants.name: durable_rate_limit_source
invariants.description: Scheduler preflight rate limits from persisted bridge-log feedback events.
must: in-memory prior_events are not the scheduler preflight source

invariants.name: priority_only_fast_track
invariants.description: Fast-track is scheduler queue priority only.

invariants.name: durable_payload_binding
invariants.description: Scheduler preflight binds the supplied ops_feedback event to source_bridge_event.payload.ops_feedback from the durable bridge log.
must: supplied feedback_id matches durable source payload
supplied query_class_hash matches durable source payload
mismatch fails closed before scheduler candidate output

out_of_scope: Operator UI for feedback submission (separate PR)
